text:
The Crew Motorfest: Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni’ihau Trailer
A new adventure is waiting to be uncovered

Step into the world of "Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni’ihau", where ancient mysteries, wild terrain and the Mercedes-Benz G 63 AMG 6x6 collide

Available with #TheCrewMotorfest Year 4 Pass or in the DLC Pack on October 7

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

UNO™: FLEX DLC Launch Trailer
UNO gets flexible with UNO Flex!
Easy to learn and full of surprises, UNO Flex brings fresh dynamics to every UNO match. Flex cards and Power mechanics let you change colors and trigger alternate effects at the perfect moment, while powerful Action cards add even more twists and impact.
